messages:
emma.martin: Hi — trying to sign up for the free trial and apply the promo code but the flow stopped with `blocked by fraud checks`. Promos not applying and account creation stuck. Not using a VPN, signed up with personal Gmail. Screenshot attached.

anna_support: Sorry about that — we'll take a look. Can you paste the last4 of the card used and the IP shown on the signup screen? Also did you try signing up from a mobile carrier or public Wi‑Fi?

emma.martin: Last4: 4242. IP: 83.212.45.101. Signed up around 2026-02-08 15:18 UTC. I was on hotel wifi earlier but switched to my phone hotspot before signing up.

fraud-bot: Automated risk flags for signup id=signup_1782345678:

```
{
  "ip_risk": "medium",
  "vpn_proxy_detected": "true",
  "geo_mismatch": "true",         // IP country != billing country
  "email_disposable": "false",
  "card_reuse_count": "3",       // same BIN seen on multiple recent signups
  "velocity": "high"
}
```

anna_support: Thanks — the bot shows a VPN/proxy detection and the card BIN has been seen on 3 signups in 24h. That triggers our automated hold. I'll loop in billing/security for manual review. @jorge_billing @irene_ops can you take this one?

irene_ops: Seen this pattern before — hotel/public wifi -> hotspot switching can trip geo/velocity checks, and card BIN reuse bumps risk. We should request a quick KYC (ID + selfie) and do a manual BIN check. If verification passes, we can lift the hold and allow the promo. Recommend phone verification if user is willing.

jorge_billing: Promo code PROMO-TRIAL-2026 applies to first-time customers only and is blocked while fraud flags are active. We can do a manual override after verification. @emma.martin if you can complete a quick verification form (photo ID + selfie) we can run a manual review and reissue the trial credits. ETA for manual review: 4–12 business hours once docs uploaded.

emma.martin: Thanks, I can do that now. Where do I upload? I prefer email link not a long form.

anna_support: Please use this secure upload link (expires in 24h): https://redwood.example/verify?token=signup_1782345678 — include the card last4 and the time of signup in the comment. Steps:
1) Upload government ID (passport/driver license) photo
2) Take a selfie holding the ID
3) Paste last4 and approximate signup time

anna_support: Once uploaded I’ll mark for expedited review and notify billing to run the override if verification is clean. :white_check_mark:

fraud-bot: Note: if the user used a disposable card or multiple accounts are tied to the BIN after manual review we keep the denial. But given geo switches + hotspot this looks borderline.

jorge_billing: Update (2026-02-09 09:12 UTC): Manual review completed — ID & selfie verified, BIN manual check shows no confirmed fraud (looks like legitimate card reuse from a family member). Hold lifted and trial credits applied. Promo code applied successfully on the account. @emma.martin you should see the trial active now.

emma.martin: Amazing — thanks everyone for the quick help! Appreciate the clear steps. :pray:

anna_support: Glad we could help — closing the thread but let us know if promo doesn't show or you hit any API auth issues when testing.
